title: Build safe cross-platform Git worktree manager
businessObjective: Make isolated implementation work repeatable without touching the finalized compatibility baseline or user work.
technicalObjective: Add a fail-closed Node Git worktree manager, package commands, and operational guide.
assumptions: Node.js and npm remain available on Windows, macOS, and Linux/WSL.
This bootstrap task may modify the listed governance-control surfaces.
acceptanceCriteria: Manager detects repository root, primary branch, remotes, and existing worktrees without assuming main.
Creation requires a ready canonical JSON task and refuses unexpected existing task branches.
Removal refuses dirty, unpushed, unmerged, or conflicted worktrees and never uses clean, reset --hard, or forced deletion.
Task packet records the created worktree path and deterministic fixture tests pass.
solEscalationTriggers: Any Git command could overwrite or delete user work.
Primary-branch discovery becomes ambiguous or removal safety cannot be proven.
rollbackExpectations: Revert only this task's committed support files; leave any independently created worktrees and branches untouched unless a separately approved removal command passes all safety gates.
